name: Green Card Tracker
description: Watches the US Visa Bulletin for your category, country and priority date, tells you each month where you stand on both charts, and answers status, history and rough ETA questions.

settings.label: Visa category
settings.help: EB1, EB2, EB3, EW (Other Workers), EB4, EB5, F1, F2A, F2B, F3 or F4.

settings.label: Country of chargeability
settings.help: India, China, Mexico, Philippines, or All (every other country).

settings.label: Your priority date
settings.help: From your I-797 receipt, as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2014-03-15. Leave empty to just follow the dates.
